message:
Review before saving. This is a first compile: there is no previous almanac, so there are no changed or removed rules. I read all 4 files in Board Documents completely. No recordings. No exclusions.

Rules found (each with its quotation):
1. Court booking: Weekdays, no more than two hours per day (since 2022-03-01). Saturdays and Sundays, no more than 90 minutes per day (since 2024-04-01, minutes 2024-03-05, carried 4-0). Sources: club-rules-2022.pdf: "A member may book a court for no more than two hours per day." committee-minutes-2024-03-05.docx: "on Saturdays and Sundays a member may book a court for no more than 90 minutes per day. Weekday booking is unchanged."
2. Guest fees: $15 per visit (since 2024-04-01, minutes 2024-03-05, carried 3-1, confirmed by minutes 2024-06-11). Superseded: $10 per visit up to 2024-03-31 (club-rules-2022.pdf: "Each guest pays a fee of $10 per visit."). The notice of 2024-03-20 stating $12 is corrected by the 2024-06-11 minutes.
3. Governance and amendments: club rules adopted 2022-03-01; may be amended by majority vote of the committee (club-rules-2022.pdf: "These rules may be amended by a majority vote of the committee.").

Open conflict (1): Court hours. club-rules-2022.pdf: "Courts are open from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. every day." notice-2024-03-20.txt: "Courts are now open from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m." No document resolves this. A motion to extend to 10:00 p.m. failed 2-2 (minutes 2024-03-05). The notice does not replace the adopted rules.

Provisional items: none. Open items: none recorded.
